tierSetting.name: Fiscal Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the State Council's fiscal stance. Stimulus boosts growth and hiring but adds cost pressure; consolidation cools inflation pressure at the expense of growth.

options.label: Consolidation
options.description: Prioritize fiscal restraint. Eases cost pressure but slows growth and hiring momentum.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a neutral fiscal stance.

options.label: Stimulus
options.description: Accelerate spending and support demand. Growth and jobs improve faster, but prices run a bit hotter.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Industrial Relief
regionalTarget.description: Direct fiscal support to one province facing weaker growth. The target province gets faster growth and labor-market support.

emergency.name: Emergency Stabilization Package
emergency.description: Deploy a temporary stabilization package for a province under acute economic stress, sharply lifting growth and employment for one turn window.

allocation.name: Central Government Transfers
allocation.description: Allocate the central government transfer pool (中央转移支付) across all 7 macro-regions. Must sum to 100%.

bondProfile.name: Sovereign Bond Maturity Profile
bondProfile.description: Set the split of quarterly sovereign debt issuance across 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year maturities.

tierSetting.name: Civil Defense Readiness
tierSetting.description: Choose the national defense readiness level. Higher readiness improves confidence and disaster coordination but raises public tension slightly.

options.label: Reduced
options.description: Lower readiness across the force, reducing upkeep. Civil-defence coverage thins with it.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Maintain normal readiness.

options.label: Elevated
options.description: Raise the readiness every formation trains toward, strengthening civil-defence resilience at higher upkeep and some public tension.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Readiness Focus
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate training and civil-defense logistics in one province to improve preparedness and public confidence.

tierSetting.name: Curriculum Focus
tierSetting.description: Choose whether to emphasize exam performance, balanced learning, or creativity and student wellbeing.

options.label: Exam Focus
options.description: Push exam preparation harder for stronger test outcomes.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain the current balance between rigor and wellbeing.

options.label: Wellbeing Focus
options.description: Reduce pressure and widen broader skills development, with more gradual exam gains.

regionalTarget.name: School Modernization Priority
regionalTarget.description: Target one province for school modernization and teacher support.

emergency.name: Teacher Retention Surge
emergency.description: Deploy emergency staffing support and retention grants to one province's school system.

tierSetting.name: Care Delivery Focus
tierSetting.description: Set whether the ministry emphasizes hospital throughput, preventive care, or balanced provision.

options.label: Hospital Focus
options.description: Improve treatment capacity and physician availability, but preventive care improves more slowly.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced health strategy.

options.label: Prevention Focus
options.description: Expand preventive care and public health outreach, improving population health over time.

regionalTarget.name: Rural Clinic Support
regionalTarget.description: Direct physicians, clinics, and care support into one underserved province.

emergency.name: Emergency Care Surge
emergency.description: Launch a rapid health workforce deployment to a strained province.

tierSetting.name: Monetary Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the PBoC's monetary policy stance. Easing stimulates growth but risks inflation; tightening cools prices but slows activity.

options.label: Tight
options.description: Raise rates and tighten liquidity to fight inflation.

options.label: Neutral
options.description: Maintain a balanced monetary stance.

options.label: Loose
options.description: Cut rates and expand liquidity to stimulate growth and employment.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Liquidity Support
regionalTarget.description: Direct credit and liquidity support to one province facing tighter financial conditions.

emergency.name: Emergency Liquidity Injection
emergency.description: Deploy emergency liquidity to stabilize credit conditions in a province under acute financial stress.

tierSetting.name: Policing Posture
tierSetting.description: Set the national policing posture. Community policing builds trust at the cost of slightly higher crime; strike-hard campaigns cut crime and lift confidence but strain public trust.

options.label: Community Policing
options.description: Emphasize local engagement and restraint. Builds public trust but crime creeps up.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain standard enforcement.

options.label: Strike Hard
options.description: Aggressive crackdown (严打). Cuts crime and raises confidence but erodes public trust.

regionalTarget.name: Provincial Security Sweep
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate policing resources in one province to cut crime and raise safety confidence.

emergency.name: Stability Maintenance Operation
emergency.description: Deploy a temporary security surge to a province under acute public-order stress, sharply cutting crime for one turn window.

tierSetting.name: Trade Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the national trade posture. Protectionism shields domestic firms but raises prices; open markets lower prices and lift growth at the expense of some domestic formation.

options.label: Protectionist
options.description: Shield domestic industry. Lifts business formation and the trade balance but raises cost of living.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a neutral trade stance.

options.label: Open Markets
options.description: Liberalize trade and investment. Boosts growth and lowers prices but pressures domestic formation and the trade balance.

regionalTarget.name: Special Economic Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one province as a special economic zone, boosting growth and business formation there.

emergency.name: Export Stabilization Drive
emergency.description: Deploy emergency export support to a province facing a trade shock, lifting growth and the trade balance for one turn window.

minister_of_human_resources_social_secur.department: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

tierSetting.name: Labor Market Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the labor-market posture. Flexibility cuts unemployment but widens inequality; worker protection narrows inequality and lifts wages but nudges unemployment up.

options.label: Flexibility
options.description: Loosen labor rules. Cuts unemployment but widens income inequality.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a neutral labor stance.

options.label: Worker Protection
options.description: Strengthen protections and wages. Narrows inequality and lifts incomes but nudges unemployment up.

regionalTarget.name: Migrant Worker Support
regionalTarget.description: Direct employment and re-skilling support to one province, cutting unemployment and lifting social mobility there.

emergency.name: Mass Re-employment Program
emergency.description: Launch an emergency hiring and retraining push in a province facing high unemployment.

tierSetting.name: Environmental Enforcement
tierSetting.description: Set the enforcement posture. Growth-first relaxes limits for output at an environmental cost; a green mandate cleans air and cuts emissions but trims growth.

options.label: Growth First
options.description: Relax environmental limits for output. Lifts growth but worsens air quality and emissions.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain current environmental enforcement.

options.label: Green Mandate
options.description: Tighten enforcement. Cleans air and cuts emissions but trims growth.

regionalTarget.name: Blue Sky Defense
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate the Blue Sky Defense campaign (蓝天保卫战) in one province to lift air quality and cut emissions there.

emergency.name: Pollution Crackdown
emergency.description: Order an emergency pollution crackdown in a province under acute air-quality stress.

tierSetting.name: Investment Priority
tierSetting.description: Set the transport investment priority. High-speed rail lifts transit but diverts road funding; a highway-and-logistics focus improves roads at the expense of transit.

options.label: High-Speed Rail
options.description: Prioritize rail and transit. Lifts public transit but road maintenance slips.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced investment mix.

options.label: Highway & Logistics
options.description: Prioritize roads and freight. Improves roads but transit slips.

regionalTarget.name: Provincial Connectivity Project
regionalTarget.description: Direct an infrastructure package to one province, closing its investment gap and improving transit.

emergency.name: Disaster Infrastructure Repair
emergency.description: Deploy emergency repair crews to a province after infrastructure failure or disaster.

minister_of_agriculture_rural_affairs.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tierSetting.name: Farm Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the agricultural policy direction. Market liberalization lifts agri-business but raises food insecurity; grain self-sufficiency secures supply at slightly higher cost.

options.label: Market Liberalization
options.description: Loosen farm controls. Lifts business formation but food insecurity rises.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced farm policy.

options.label: Grain Self-Sufficiency
options.description: Prioritize domestic grain supply. Secures food but raises cost of living slightly.

regionalTarget.name: Rural Revitalization Zone
regionalTarget.description: Target one province for rural revitalization investment, lifting rural vitality and cutting poverty.

emergency.name: Grain Reserve Release
emergency.description: Release central grain reserves to a province facing acute food insecurity.

minister_of_housing_urban_rural.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development

tierSetting.name: Housing Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the housing posture. Market development lowers prices via supply but does little for homelessness directly; an affordable mandate (房住不炒) cuts homelessness at a small cost-of-living cost.

options.label: Market Development
options.description: Spur private development. Lifts supply and lowers cost of living but homelessness creeps up.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced housing policy.

options.label: Affordable Mandate
options.description: Houses for living, not speculation (房住不炒). Cuts homelessness but cost of living ticks up.

regionalTarget.name: Urban Renewal Project
regionalTarget.description: Direct an urban renewal package to one province, cutting homelessness and supporting urbanization.

emergency.name: Affordable Housing Surge
emergency.description: Deploy emergency affordable-housing support to a province facing a housing crisis.

premier.name: National Unity Campaign
premier.description: Launch a nationwide messaging campaign to reinforce confidence in State Council leadership.

premier.name: Bureaucratic Efficiency Drive
premier.description: Streamline inter-ministry coordination to improve government responsiveness and transparency.

vice_premier.name: Economic Coordination Push
vice_premier.description: Coordinate cross-ministry economic planning to boost growth and reduce unemployment.

vice_premier.name: Anti-Corruption Sweep
vice_premier.description: Direct central inspectors to pursue graft and restore public confidence in clean governance.

state_councillor.name: Policy Coordination Boost
state_councillor.description: Improve inter-agency policy alignment to strengthen implementation across provinces.

state_councillor.name: Provincial Outreach Program
state_councillor.description: Send senior advisers to provinces to gather feedback and improve regional satisfaction.

minister_of_foreign_affairs.name: Major Trade Delegation
minister_of_foreign_affairs.description: Lead a high-level trade delegation to secure agreements and improve foreign market access.

minister_of_foreign_affairs.name: Diplomatic Summit Hosting
minister_of_foreign_affairs.description: Host a major regional summit to elevate China's diplomatic standing and international goodwill.

minister_of_finance.name: Fiscal Stimulus Package
minister_of_finance.description: Deploy a targeted fiscal package to support demand and employment nationwide.

minister_of_finance.name: Employment Subsidy Program
minister_of_finance.description: Fund an emergency employment subsidy for small and medium-sized firms to keep workers attached to the labor market.

minister_of_defense.name: Civil Defense Drill
minister_of_defense.description: Coordinate a large-scale civil-defense and disaster-readiness exercise with the PLA.

minister_of_defense.name: Defense White Paper Rollout
minister_of_defense.description: Publish and communicate a major readiness review to improve public confidence in national preparedness.

minister_of_education.name: Education Excellence Initiative
minister_of_education.description: Deploy additional support for classroom quality and teacher development to improve student outcomes.

minister_of_education.name: National Skills Training Program
minister_of_education.description: Partner with industry and schools on an intensive upskilling and technical training push.

minister_of_health.name: Rural Health Expansion
minister_of_health.description: Fund a temporary expansion of rural healthcare capacity and staffing across underserved provinces.

minister_of_health.name: Public Health Campaign
minister_of_health.description: Run a nationwide public-health education and preventive-care campaign.

pboc_governor.name: Targeted Credit Easing
pboc_governor.description: Direct banks to expand lending to priority sectors, boosting short-term growth.

pboc_governor.name: Financial Stability Program
pboc_governor.description: Tighten macro-prudential rules to cool speculative excess and stabilize the financial system.

minister_of_public_security.name: Anti-Corruption Inspection
minister_of_public_security.description: Dispatch central inspectors to root out graft and restore public confidence.

minister_of_public_security.name: Social Credit Rollout
minister_of_public_security.description: Expand the social credit system to deter offenses and improve public order.

minister_of_commerce.name: Belt and Road Investment Push
minister_of_commerce.description: Sign new Belt and Road partnerships to open markets and lift growth.

minister_of_commerce.name: Foreign Investment Liberalization
minister_of_commerce.description: Ease the foreign-investment negative list to spur new enterprise.

minister_of_human_resources_social_secur.name: Social Security Expansion
minister_of_human_resources_social_secur.description: Broaden pension and benefit coverage to narrow inequality.

minister_of_human_resources_social_secur.name: Emergency Hiring Subsidy
minister_of_human_resources_social_secur.description: Fund a temporary hiring subsidy for firms to keep workers employed.

minister_of_ecology_environment.name: National Carbon Market Push
minister_of_ecology_environment.description: Tighten the national carbon market to cut emissions and spur renewables.

minister_of_ecology_environment.name: River-Chief Cleanup
minister_of_ecology_environment.description: Mobilize the river-chief system (河长制) for a nationwide water and resilience drive.

minister_of_transport.name: National Rail Expansion
minister_of_transport.description: Accelerate high-speed rail buildout to raise transit quality nationwide.

minister_of_transport.name: Rural Road Initiative
minister_of_transport.description: Fund a rural road program to improve roads and rural vitality.

minister_of_agriculture_rural_affairs.name: Targeted Poverty Alleviation
minister_of_agriculture_rural_affairs.description: Run a targeted poverty-alleviation campaign (精准扶贫) in rural areas.

minister_of_agriculture_rural_affairs.name: High-Standard Farmland Drive
minister_of_agriculture_rural_affairs.description: Upgrade farmland to high-standard plots to secure grain output.

minister_of_housing_urban_rural.name: Shantytown Redevelopment
minister_of_housing_urban_rural.description: Fund a shantytown redevelopment push (棚改) to expand housing supply.

minister_of_housing_urban_rural.name: Property Market Stabilization
minister_of_housing_urban_rural.description: Steady the property market to ease housing-driven cost pressure.
